metadata.title: Polished Concrete Warehouse Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: A tired epoxy coating and chipped joints had to go in this storage warehouse. We ground the slab down to polished concrete and cut fresh joints, so the floor looks clean and can take daily forklift traffic. #commercialflooring #polishedconcrete

metadata.title: Polished Concrete Retail Store Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: This shop had a waxed floor that was showing its age in every aisle. We took it down and polished the concrete, so now there is no wax to strip and cleaning is a quick job. #commercialflooring

metadata.title: Matching Epoxy-Flake Garage and Patio
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: New owners asked us to coat both the garage and the back patio with the same flake system. It handles the outdoor weather well and gives them a good spot to host friends. #residentialflooring

metadata.title: Seamless Epoxy Dining Room Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: We coated this restaurant dining room with a seamless epoxy system. With no grout lines to scrub, the staff can mop it down fast, and the lighter color opens up the room. #commercialflooring

metadata.title: Epoxy-Flake Lakeside Patio Coating
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: This lakeside patio now has the same flake blend as the garage next to it. #residentialflooring

metadata.title: Epoxy-Flake Lake House Garage Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: We put down an epoxy-flake floor in the garage of this waterfront home. Boats, coolers and wet gear can all sit on it without the owners giving it a second thought. #residentialflooring

metadata.title: Epoxy-Flake Auto Service Bay Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: We finished an epoxy-flake floor in the service bays at a local auto shop. Oil and road grime clean up easily, and the textured surface gives the techs secure footing. #commercialflooring

metadata.title: Sealed Concrete Agricultural Building Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: Years of tile adhesive covered the slab in this farm co-op building. We ground it clean and applied a tough sealer, and the old concrete came up with rich color. #commercialflooring

metadata.title: Epoxy-Chip Backyard Patio Coating
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: This backyard slab got an epoxy-chip coating and a whole new look. It is built for Red Mesa sun and storms, and the family finally has a patio they want to use. #residentialflooring

metadata.title: Polished Concrete Manufacturing Shop Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: We are polishing this manufacturing shop floor one section at a time. Working in stages lets their team stay in production while we move across the slab. #commercialflooring

metadata.title: Resinous Butcher Shop Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: To close out a grocery remodel, we laid a resinous coating across the butcher area. It lines up with the walk-in cooler floor we did for the same store a few weeks earlier. #resinousflooring #commercialflooring

metadata.title: New-Build Garage Epoxy-Chip Coating
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: One of the last jobs on this new home was the garage floor. We coated it with epoxy chips in a salt-and-pepper blend just before the owners moved in. #residentialflooring

metadata.title: Polished Concrete Showroom Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: We polished this dealership showroom floor and got it ready for the inventory to roll back in. #CommercialFlooring

metadata.title: Garage Floor Coating From Slab to Finish
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: This garage went from a bare slab to a finished coating in a few careful steps: walk the job, prep the concrete, then roll the coat.

metadata.title: Resinous Walk-In Cooler Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: A new walk-in meat cooler at a grocery store needed a tough floor, so we installed a resinous system. The cutting room floor is next on our list. #concrete #decorativeflooring #commercialflooring #concretefloors

metadata.title: Self-Leveling Resinous Food Prep Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: A worn rubber floor came out of this grocery prep room so we could pour a self-leveling resinous system. The crew now has one continuous surface from wall to wall.

metadata.title: Sealed Concrete Retail Display Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: Old VCT came up at this farm and ranch store so we could seal the concrete underneath. Products show well on the glossy surface, and upkeep is simple.

metadata.title: Epoxy-Chip Home Garage Floor
metadata.author: Bedrock Flooring
metadata.excerpt: We wrapped up this home garage with a black and white chip blend. The textured finish hides dust between cleanings and rinses off without much effort.
